name: Bandar Abbas port
note: Major commercial port on the northern shore of the strait.

name: Bandar Abbas desalination intake
note: Seawater intake for municipal desalination; intakes are sensitive to floating oil.

name: Hara mangrove protected area
note: Grey mangrove (Avicennia marina) forest between Qeshm and the mainland; protected area.

name: Hormuz Island coast
note: Island shoreline east of Bandar Abbas.

name: Larak Island coast
note: Island shoreline close to the shipping lanes.

name: Khasab port
note: Main port of the Musandam peninsula.

name: Khor Sham coral reefs
note: Fjord-like inlet with fringing coral communities.

name: Kumzar village coast
note: Coastal village near the tip of the Musandam peninsula, reached by sea.

name: Ras Al Khaimah desalination intake
note: Seawater intake on the Ras Al Khaimah coast.

name: Saqr port
note: Bulk and container port north of Ras Al Khaimah.

name: Ras Musandam coast
note: Northern tip of the Musandam peninsula; rocky coast and fishing grounds.

name: Northern Musandam reefs
note: Fringing coral reefs used for diving and fishing.

name: Traffic separation scheme, inbound lane
note: Approximate centreline of the westbound (inbound) lane; for orientation only.

name: Traffic separation scheme, outbound lane
note: Approximate centreline of the eastbound (outbound) lane; for orientation only.
